## Verification

Fixture run (2026-10, 120 invoices → 95 rows):

```
CHF 20 10754.55
EUR 75 43418.43
skipped 25
```

Checked independently, not via the writer's own accumulators: gross totals recomputed from the CSV rows match, zero `\r` bytes in either file, trailing LF present, every `net`/`vat`/`gross` exactly 2dp. Half-even is proven by cases where it differs from half-up (CH 5.00 → 0.405 → **0.40**, CH 15.00 → 1.215 → **1.22**); the DE 0.50 tie lands on 0.10 under both rules, so it guards the arithmetic, not the mode.
